description.zh-CN: 任何讲 OpenAI Chat Completions 协议的上游。服务商地址写到 API 根（如 https://api.example.com/v1），凭证是一个 API Key。
description.en: Any upstream that speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions wire. The provider endpoint is the API root (such as https://api.example.com/v1); the credential is one API key.

description.zh-CN: OpenAI 官方 API，经 Responses 接口调用；对话、Messages 与 Responses 三个入口都发往 /responses。凭证是一个 API Key。
description.en: The official OpenAI API through the Responses API; the Chat, Messages and Responses surfaces all call /responses. The credential is one API key.

description.zh-CN: Anthropic 官方 Messages 接口（api.anthropic.com）。凭证是一个 API Key。
description.en: The official Anthropic Messages API (api.anthropic.com). The credential is one API key.

description.zh-CN: Google Gemini API 的 generateContent 接口（generativelanguage.googleapis.com）。凭证是一个 API Key。
description.en: The Google Gemini API's generateContent (generativelanguage.googleapis.com). The credential is one API key.

description.zh-CN: Gemini API 提供的 OpenAI 兼容接口（/v1beta/openai）。凭证是 Gemini API Key。
description.en: The OpenAI-compatible surface of the Gemini API (/v1beta/openai). The credential is a Gemini API key.

description.zh-CN: Azure OpenAI 不带版本号的 v1 接口。服务商地址写到 {资源}/openai/v1，凭证是资源的 API Key。
description.en: Azure OpenAI's unversioned v1 surface. The provider endpoint is {resource}/openai/v1; the credential is the resource's API key.

max_tokens_field.zh-CN: 输出上限放在请求体的哪个键里：缺省 max_completion_tokens；只认旧键的部署选 max_tokens。
max_tokens_field.en: The body key the output cap is sent under: max_completion_tokens by default, or max_tokens for a deployment that accepts only the legacy key.

description.zh-CN: Azure OpenAI 按部署寻址、带 ?api-version= 日期版本的接口。服务商地址写资源根，凭证是资源的 API Key。
description.en: Azure OpenAI addressed by deployment with a dated ?api-version=. The provider endpoint is the resource root; the credential is the resource's API key.

api_version.zh-CN: 以 ?api-version= 发送的 API 版本，日期形式，可带 -preview 后缀（如 2025-04-01-preview），缺省 2024-10-21。用不带版本号的 v1 接口时改选「Azure OpenAI · v1」。
api_version.en: The API version sent as ?api-version=, a date with an optional -preview suffix such as 2025-04-01-preview; defaults to 2024-10-21. For the unversioned v1 surface use Azure OpenAI · v1 instead.

max_tokens_field.zh-CN: 输出上限放在请求体的哪个键里：缺省 max_completion_tokens；只认旧键的部署选 max_tokens。
max_tokens_field.en: The body key the output cap is sent under: max_completion_tokens by default, or max_tokens for a deployment that accepts only the legacy key.

description.zh-CN: AWS Bedrock 的 Converse 接口，网关用 IAM 访问密钥按 SigV4 签名。
description.en: AWS Bedrock's Converse API, signed by the gateway with SigV4 from IAM access keys.

region.zh-CN: 调用 Bedrock 运行时的 AWS 区域，例如 us-east-1。
region.en: The AWS region the Bedrock runtime is called in, such as us-east-1.

access_key_id.zh-CN: 用于签名请求的 IAM 主体的 AWS 访问密钥 ID。
access_key_id.en: The AWS access key ID of the IAM principal the requests are signed as.

secret_access_key.zh-CN: 与访问密钥 ID 配对的 AWS 秘密访问密钥。
secret_access_key.en: The AWS secret access key paired with the access key ID.

session_token.zh-CN: AWS 会话令牌，只有 AWS STS 签发的临时凭证才需要。
session_token.en: The AWS session token, only for temporary credentials from AWS STS.

description.zh-CN: AWS Bedrock 的 Converse 接口，用 Bedrock API Key（Bearer）认证，不签名。
description.en: AWS Bedrock's Converse API, authenticated with a Bedrock API key (bearer) instead of signing.

region.zh-CN: 调用 Bedrock 运行时的 AWS 区域，例如 us-east-1。
region.en: The AWS region the Bedrock runtime is called in, such as us-east-1.

display_name.zh-CN: AWS Bedrock · Claude 原生调用

description.zh-CN: 经 AWS Bedrock 的 InvokeModel 以 Anthropic Messages 原生格式调用 Claude，网关用 IAM 访问密钥按 SigV4 签名。
description.en: Claude in the Anthropic Messages format through AWS Bedrock InvokeModel, signed by the gateway with SigV4 from IAM access keys.

region.zh-CN: 调用 Bedrock 运行时的 AWS 区域，例如 us-east-1。
region.en: The AWS region the Bedrock runtime is called in, such as us-east-1.

access_key_id.zh-CN: 用于签名请求的 IAM 主体的 AWS 访问密钥 ID。
access_key_id.en: The AWS access key ID of the IAM principal the requests are signed as.

secret_access_key.zh-CN: 与访问密钥 ID 配对的 AWS 秘密访问密钥。
secret_access_key.en: The AWS secret access key paired with the access key ID.

session_token.zh-CN: AWS 会话令牌，只有 AWS STS 签发的临时凭证才需要。
session_token.en: The AWS session token, only for temporary credentials from AWS STS.

description.zh-CN: AWS Bedrock 的 OpenAI 兼容接口（bedrock-mantle），经 Responses 接口调用；凭证是 Bedrock API Key。
description.en: AWS Bedrock's OpenAI-compatible surface (bedrock-mantle), called through the Responses API; the credential is a Bedrock API key.

region.zh-CN: 提供模型的 bedrock-mantle 主机所在的 AWS 区域，例如 us-east-1；网关用它填出服务商地址。
region.en: The AWS region whose bedrock-mantle host serves the models, such as us-east-1; the gateway fills the endpoint with it.

description.zh-CN: Google Vertex AI 上的 Gemini 文本模型，凭证是服务账号密钥，网关用它签发访问令牌。
description.en: Gemini text models on Google Vertex AI; the credential is a service account key the gateway mints access tokens from.

region.zh-CN: Vertex AI 的区域，例如 us-central1，或 global。
region.en: The Vertex AI location, such as us-central1, or global.

project.zh-CN: 要调用的 Google Cloud 项目，与服务账号所属项目不同时才填。
project.en: The Google Cloud project to call, when it is not the service account's own.

service_account.zh-CN: 用来签发访问令牌的服务账号密钥文件（JSON）。
service_account.en: The service account key file (JSON) access tokens are minted with.

project_id.zh-CN: 服务账号所属的 Google Cloud 项目。
project_id.en: The Google Cloud project the service account belongs to.

display_name.zh-CN: 阿里云百炼 · OpenAI 兼容

description.zh-CN: 阿里云百炼（Model Studio）的 OpenAI 兼容对话接口；支持思考预算的型号会把输出上限拆成思考与回答两部分。凭证是百炼 API Key。
description.en: The OpenAI-compatible chat surface of Alibaba Cloud Model Studio; for models with a thinking budget the output cap is split between thinking and answer. The credential is a Model Studio API key.

description.zh-CN: 用 Claude 订阅账号的 Claude Code 登录凭证调用；网关用刷新令牌换取访问令牌，并写回轮换后的刷新令牌。
description.en: A Claude subscription through the Claude Code sign-in; the gateway exchanges the refresh token for access tokens and writes back the rotated refresh token.

refresh_token.zh-CN: Claude Code 刷新令牌，即 CLI 的 .credentials.json 里的 claudeAiOauth.refreshToken；每次刷新都会轮换并写回。没有刷新令牌的是长期令牌，改选「Claude Code 订阅（长期令牌）」。
refresh_token.en: The Claude Code refresh token, claudeAiOauth.refreshToken in the CLI's .credentials.json; rotated on every refresh and written back. A token without one is a setup token: use Claude Code subscription (setup token).

display_name.zh-CN: Claude Code 订阅（长期令牌）

description.zh-CN: 用 claude setup-token 生成的长期令牌调用 Claude 订阅；凭证就是这个令牌，不需要刷新。
description.en: A Claude subscription through a long-lived token made with claude setup-token; the credential is that token and is not refreshed.

description.zh-CN: 用 ChatGPT 订阅账号的 Codex CLI 登录凭证调用；网关用刷新令牌换取访问令牌，并写回轮换后的刷新令牌。
description.en: A ChatGPT subscription through the Codex CLI sign-in; the gateway exchanges the refresh token for access tokens and writes back the rotated refresh token.

access_token.zh-CN: Codex 访问令牌，如 Codex CLI 的 auth.json 里的 tokens.access_token；没存刷新令牌时直接使用。
access_token.en: A Codex access token, such as tokens.access_token in the Codex CLI's auth.json; used as is when no refresh token is stored.

refresh_token.zh-CN: Codex 刷新令牌，如 auth.json 里的 tokens.refresh_token；每次刷新都会轮换并写回。
refresh_token.en: The Codex refresh token, such as tokens.refresh_token in auth.json; rotated on every refresh and written back.

account_id.zh-CN: ChatGPT 账号 ID，如 auth.json 里的 tokens.account_id；作为 chatgpt-account-id 发送，刷新到别的账号会被拒绝。
account_id.en: The ChatGPT account id, such as tokens.account_id in auth.json; sent as chatgpt-account-id, and a refresh naming another account is refused.

description.zh-CN: 用有 Copilot 席位的 GitHub 账号调用；网关用 GitHub OAuth 令牌换取 Copilot 令牌。
description.en: A GitHub account with a Copilot seat; the gateway exchanges its GitHub OAuth token for Copilot tokens.

plan.zh-CN: 账号的 Copilot 套餐，决定调用哪个 GitHub 对话主机：individual（Pro 与 Pro+）、business 或 enterprise。必填：Business / Enterprise 账号配成 individual 只会在上游拒绝时才暴露。
plan.en: The account's Copilot plan, which selects GitHub's chat API host: individual (Pro and Pro+), business or enterprise. Required: a Business or Enterprise account set to individual fails only when the upstream refuses it.

github_token.zh-CN: 有 Copilot 席位的账号的 GitHub OAuth 令牌，如编辑器 github-copilot/apps.json 或 hosts.json 里的 oauth_token。
github_token.en: A GitHub OAuth token from an account with a Copilot seat, such as the oauth_token in the editor's github-copilot/apps.json or hosts.json.

description.zh-CN: 用 Kiro 登录凭证（kiro-auth-token.json）调用；网关用刷新令牌换取访问令牌并写回轮换后的刷新令牌。上游不报 token 用量。
description.en: A Kiro sign-in (kiro-auth-token.json); the gateway exchanges the refresh token for access tokens and writes back the rotated refresh token. The upstream reports no token usage.

refresh_token.zh-CN: Kiro 刷新令牌，即 kiro-auth-token.json 里的 refreshToken；只能用一次，每次刷新都会轮换并写回。
refresh_token.en: The Kiro refresh token, refreshToken in kiro-auth-token.json; single use, rotated on every refresh and written back.

client_id.zh-CN: IAM Identity Center 客户端 ID，即 kiro-auth-token.json 里的 clientId；只有企业版与 Identity Center 登录才有。
client_id.en: The IAM Identity Center client id, clientId in kiro-auth-token.json; only enterprise and Identity Center sign-ins have one.

client_secret.zh-CN: IAM Identity Center 客户端密钥，即 kiro-auth-token.json 里的 clientSecret；只有企业版与 Identity Center 登录才有。
client_secret.en: The IAM Identity Center client secret, clientSecret in kiro-auth-token.json; only enterprise and Identity Center sign-ins have one.

auth_method.zh-CN: 登录方式，即 kiro-auth-token.json 里的 authMethod：IdC、enterprise 或 iam_identity_center 经 Identity Center 刷新，其他值经 Kiro 登录服务刷新；不填时，有客户端 ID 与密钥的凭证经 Identity Center 刷新。
auth_method.en: The sign-in method, authMethod in kiro-auth-token.json: IdC, enterprise or iam_identity_center refresh through Identity Center, any other value through the Kiro sign-in service; without it, a credential with a client id and secret refreshes through Identity Center.

auth_region.zh-CN: 刷新令牌所在的区域，即 kiro-auth-token.json 里的 idcRegion，没有则取 region。
auth_region.en: The region the token is refreshed in, idcRegion or else region in kiro-auth-token.json.

profile_arn.zh-CN: CodeWhisperer 配置 ARN，即 kiro-auth-token.json 里的 profileArn；有就随每个请求发送。
profile_arn.en: The CodeWhisperer profile ARN, profileArn in kiro-auth-token.json; sent with every request when present.

display_name.zh-CN: 智谱 GLM 编程套餐

description.zh-CN: 智谱 / Z.AI GLM 编程套餐（Coding Plan）的 OpenAI 兼容接口。服务商地址写套餐的 API 根，凭证是 Z.AI 控制台的 API Key（不刷新）。
description.en: The OpenAI-compatible API of the Z.AI GLM Coding Plan. The provider endpoint is the plan's API root; the credential is an API key from the Z.AI dashboard (not refreshed).

description.zh-CN: Kimi 编程套餐（Kimi Code）的 OpenAI 兼容接口。服务商地址写套餐的 API 根，凭证是套餐的 API Key。
description.en: The OpenAI-compatible API of the Kimi Code plan. The provider endpoint is the plan's API root; the credential is the plan's API key.

description.zh-CN: 可灵（Kling）视频生成任务。凭证是可灵开放平台的 Access Key 与 Secret Key，网关用它们签 JWT。
description.en: Kling video generation tasks. The credential is the Kling open platform's access key and secret key, which the gateway signs a JWT with.

access_key.zh-CN: 可灵开放平台的 Access Key。
access_key.en: The Kling open platform access key.

secret_key.zh-CN: 与 Access Key 配对的 Secret Key，用来签 JWT。
secret_key.en: The secret key paired with the access key, used to sign the JWT.

description.zh-CN: MiniMax 海螺（Hailuo）与 H3 视频生成任务。凭证是 MiniMax API Key。
description.en: MiniMax Hailuo and H3 video generation tasks. The credential is a MiniMax API key.

display_name.zh-CN: 阿里云百炼 · 万相视频
display_name.en: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio · Wan video

description.zh-CN: 阿里云百炼（Model Studio）上的万相等视频生成任务。凭证是百炼 API Key。
description.en: Wan and other video generation tasks on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio. The credential is a Model Studio API key.

description.zh-CN: BytePlus 上的 Seedance 视频生成任务。凭证是 BytePlus API Key。
description.en: Seedance video generation tasks on BytePlus. The credential is a BytePlus API key.

description.zh-CN: xAI Grok Imagine 视频生成任务。凭证是 xAI API Key。
description.en: xAI Grok Imagine video generation tasks. The credential is an xAI API key.

description.zh-CN: 经 Gemini API 调用的 Veo 视频生成任务。凭证是 Gemini API Key。
description.en: Veo video generation tasks through the Gemini API. The credential is a Gemini API key.

description.zh-CN: 经 Vertex AI 调用的 Veo 视频生成任务。服务商地址写到 location 前缀，凭证是服务账号密钥。
description.en: Veo video generation tasks through Vertex AI. The provider endpoint includes the location prefix; the credential is a service account key.

service_account.zh-CN: 用来签发访问令牌的服务账号密钥文件（JSON）。
service_account.en: The service account key file (JSON) access tokens are minted with.

project_id.zh-CN: 服务账号所属的 Google Cloud 项目。
project_id.en: The Google Cloud project the service account belongs to.

display_name.zh-CN: Gemini Omni 视频 · Gemini API

description.zh-CN: 经 Gemini API 的 Interactions 接口调用的 Gemini Omni 视频生成任务。凭证是 Gemini API Key。
description.en: Gemini Omni video generation tasks through the Gemini API's Interactions API. The credential is a Gemini API key.

display_name.zh-CN: Gemini Omni 视频 · Vertex AI

description.zh-CN: 经 Vertex AI 的 Interactions 接口调用的 Gemini Omni 视频生成任务。服务商地址写到 location 前缀，凭证是服务账号密钥。
description.en: Gemini Omni video generation tasks through Vertex AI's Interactions API. The provider endpoint includes the location prefix; the credential is a service account key.

service_account.zh-CN: 用来签发访问令牌的服务账号密钥文件（JSON）。
service_account.en: The service account key file (JSON) access tokens are minted with.

project_id.zh-CN: 服务账号所属的 Google Cloud 项目。
project_id.en: The Google Cloud project the service account belongs to.

description.zh-CN: 阿里云百炼上的万相图像生成任务（经图像入口按型号路由）。凭证是百炼 API Key。
description.en: Wan image generation tasks on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, routed per model from the image surface. The credential is a Model Studio API key.

description.zh-CN: GMI Cloud 的图像生成任务（经图像入口按型号路由）。
description.en: GMI Cloud image generation tasks, routed per model from the image surface.

organization_id.zh-CN: GMI Cloud 组织 ID；填了就作为 X-Organization-ID 发送。
organization_id.en: The GMI Cloud organization id, sent as X-Organization-ID when set.

description.zh-CN: 讲 OpenAI `/audio/speech` 与 `/audio/transcriptions` 协议的上游：语音合成、识别与翻译。服务商地址写到 API 根，凭证是一个 API Key。
description.en: Any upstream that speaks OpenAI's `/audio/speech` and `/audio/transcriptions`: synthesis, recognition and translation. The provider endpoint is the API root; the credential is one API key.

description.zh-CN: Azure OpenAI 不带版本号的 v1 语音接口（合成、识别、翻译）。服务商地址写到 {资源}/openai/v1，凭证是资源的 API Key。
description.en: Azure OpenAI's unversioned v1 speech surface (synthesis, recognition, translation). The provider endpoint is {resource}/openai/v1; the credential is the resource's API key.

display_name.zh-CN: Azure OpenAI 语音 · 按日期版本

description.zh-CN: Azure OpenAI 按部署寻址、带 ?api-version= 日期版本的语音接口。服务商地址写资源根，凭证是资源的 API Key。
description.en: Azure OpenAI speech addressed by deployment with a dated ?api-version=. The provider endpoint is the resource root; the credential is the resource's API key.

api_version.zh-CN: 以 ?api-version= 发送的 API 版本，日期形式，可带 -preview 后缀，缺省 2024-10-21。
api_version.en: The API version sent as ?api-version=, a date with an optional -preview suffix; defaults to 2024-10-21.

description.zh-CN: Azure AI 语音服务：快速转写识别与 SSML 语音合成。凭证是语音资源的密钥。
description.en: Azure AI Speech: fast transcription and SSML synthesis. The credential is the Speech resource key.

display_name.zh-CN: Google Vertex AI · Gemini 语音合成

description.zh-CN: Vertex AI 上的 Gemini TTS 语音合成，凭证是服务账号密钥，网关用它签发访问令牌。
description.en: Gemini TTS synthesis on Vertex AI; the credential is a service account key the gateway mints access tokens from.

region.zh-CN: Vertex AI 的位置，例如 us-central1、global，或多区域 us / eu。
region.en: The Vertex AI location, such as us-central1, global, or the us / eu multi-regions.

project.zh-CN: 要调用的 Google Cloud 项目，与服务账号所属项目不同时才填。
project.en: The Google Cloud project to call, when it is not the service account's own.

service_account.zh-CN: 用来签发访问令牌的服务账号密钥文件（JSON）。
service_account.en: The service account key file (JSON) access tokens are minted with.

project_id.zh-CN: 服务账号所属的 Google Cloud 项目。
project_id.en: The Google Cloud project the service account belongs to.

display_name.zh-CN: 阿里云百炼 · 千问语音
display_name.en: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio · Qwen speech

description.zh-CN: 百炼上的千问 TTS 合成与千问 ASR 识别（HTTP 单次请求；Realtime 型号不在服务范围）。凭证是百炼 API Key。
description.en: Qwen TTS synthesis and Qwen ASR recognition on Model Studio (one-shot HTTP; Realtime models are not served). The credential is a Model Studio API key.

description.zh-CN: 百炼 SpeechSynthesizer 接口上的 Qwen-Audio-TTS 与 CosyVoice 合成；没有缺省音色，须给对应系列的有效音色。凭证是百炼 API Key。
description.en: Qwen-Audio-TTS and CosyVoice synthesis through Model Studio's SpeechSynthesizer API; there is no default voice, so a valid voice of the series is required. The credential is a Model Studio API key.

display_name.zh-CN: 阿里云百炼 · MiniMax 语音合成
display_name.en: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio · MiniMax speech

description.zh-CN: 百炼托管的 MiniMax 语音合成（型号 ID 形如 MiniMax/speech-*）。凭证是百炼 API Key。
description.en: MiniMax synthesis hosted by Model Studio (model ids like MiniMax/speech-*). The credential is a Model Studio API key.

description.zh-CN: MiniMax 官方语音合成接口。凭证是 MiniMax API Key；中国站账号可另填 GroupId。
description.en: MiniMax's own speech synthesis API. The credential is a MiniMax API key; a China-site account may also set its GroupId.

group_id.zh-CN: MiniMax 账号的 GroupId，填了就以 ?GroupId= 附在请求上。
group_id.en: The MiniMax account's GroupId, appended to the request as ?GroupId= when set.

description.zh-CN: ElevenLabs 语音合成与识别。凭证是 ElevenLabs API Key（xi-api-key）。
description.en: ElevenLabs synthesis and recognition. The credential is an ElevenLabs API key (xi-api-key).

description.zh-CN: Groq 的语音合成接口。凭证是 Groq API Key。
description.en: Groq's speech synthesis API. The credential is a Groq API key.

display_name.zh-CN: 小米 MiMo 语音合成

description.zh-CN: 小米 MiMo 的语音合成接口。凭证是 MiMo API Key。
description.en: Xiaomi MiMo's speech synthesis API. The credential is a MiMo API key.

description.zh-CN: xAI 的语音合成与识别接口。凭证是 xAI API Key。
description.en: xAI's speech synthesis and recognition API. The credential is an xAI API key.

description.zh-CN: 讲 OpenAI `/images/generations` 与 `/images/edits` 协议的上游。服务商地址写到 API 根，凭证是一个 API Key。
description.en: Any upstream that speaks OpenAI's `/images/generations` and `/images/edits`. The provider endpoint is the API root; the credential is one API key.

description.zh-CN: Azure OpenAI 不带版本号的 v1 图像接口。服务商地址写到 {资源}/openai/v1，凭证是资源的 API Key。
description.en: Azure OpenAI's unversioned v1 image surface. The provider endpoint is {resource}/openai/v1; the credential is the resource's API key.

display_name.zh-CN: Azure OpenAI 图像 · 按日期版本

description.zh-CN: Azure OpenAI 按部署寻址、带 ?api-version= 日期版本的图像接口。服务商地址写资源根，凭证是资源的 API Key。
description.en: Azure OpenAI images addressed by deployment with a dated ?api-version=. The provider endpoint is the resource root; the credential is the resource's API key.

api_version.zh-CN: 以 ?api-version= 发送的 API 版本，日期形式，可带 -preview 后缀，缺省 2024-10-21。
api_version.en: The API version sent as ?api-version=, a date with an optional -preview suffix; defaults to 2024-10-21.

display_name.zh-CN: 智谱 GLM 编程套餐 · 图像

description.zh-CN: 智谱 / Z.AI GLM 编程套餐（Coding Plan）的 OpenAI 兼容图像接口。服务商地址写套餐的 API 根，凭证是 Z.AI 控制台的 API Key。
description.en: The OpenAI-compatible image API of the Z.AI GLM Coding Plan. The provider endpoint is the plan's API root; the credential is an API key from the Z.AI dashboard.

display_name.zh-CN: Azure AI Foundry · MAI 图像

description.zh-CN: Azure AI Foundry 上的 Microsoft MAI-Image 系列图像生成与编辑。服务商地址写 Foundry 资源根，凭证是资源的 API Key。
description.en: Image generation and editing with Microsoft's MAI-Image models on Azure AI Foundry. The provider endpoint is the Foundry resource root; the credential is the resource's API key.

description.zh-CN: Google Gemini API 的 generateContent 图像生成与编辑（Nano Banana 系列）。凭证是一个 API Key。
description.en: Image generation and editing through the Google Gemini API's generateContent (the Nano Banana models). The credential is one API key.

display_name.zh-CN: Google Vertex AI · Gemini 图像

description.zh-CN: Vertex AI 上的 Gemini 图像生成与编辑（Nano Banana 系列），凭证是服务账号密钥，网关用它签发访问令牌。
description.en: Gemini image generation and editing (the Nano Banana models) on Vertex AI; the credential is a service account key the gateway mints access tokens from.

region.zh-CN: Vertex AI 的区域，例如 us-central1，或 global。
region.en: The Vertex AI location, such as us-central1, or global.

project.zh-CN: 要调用的 Google Cloud 项目，与服务账号所属项目不同时才填。
project.en: The Google Cloud project to call, when it is not the service account's own.

service_account.zh-CN: 用来签发访问令牌的服务账号密钥文件（JSON）。
service_account.en: The service account key file (JSON) access tokens are minted with.

project_id.zh-CN: 服务账号所属的 Google Cloud 项目。
project_id.en: The Google Cloud project the service account belongs to.

display_name.zh-CN: 阿里云百炼 · 千问图像

description.zh-CN: 百炼上的千问图像（Qwen-Image）生成与编辑。凭证是百炼 API Key。
description.en: Qwen-Image generation and editing on Model Studio. The credential is a Model Studio API key.

description.zh-CN: MiniMax 官方图像生成接口。凭证是 MiniMax API Key；中国站账号可另填 GroupId。
description.en: MiniMax's own image generation API. The credential is a MiniMax API key; a China-site account may also set its GroupId.

group_id.zh-CN: MiniMax 账号的 GroupId，填了就以 ?GroupId= 附在请求上。
group_id.en: The MiniMax account's GroupId, appended to the request as ?GroupId= when set.

description.zh-CN: xAI 的 Grok Imagine 图像生成与编辑接口。凭证是 xAI API Key。
description.en: xAI's Grok Imagine image generation and editing API. The credential is an xAI API key.

description.zh-CN: Ideogram 官方图像接口。凭证是 Ideogram API Key。
description.en: Ideogram's own image API. The credential is an Ideogram API key.

description.zh-CN: Stability AI 官方图像接口（Stable Diffusion 3.5、Stable Image）。凭证是 Stability API Key。
description.en: Stability AI's own image API (Stable Diffusion 3.5, Stable Image). The credential is a Stability API key.

description.zh-CN: Reve 官方图像接口，按积分计价。凭证是 Reve API Key。
description.en: Reve's own image API, priced in credits. The credential is a Reve API key.

description.zh-CN: 讲 OpenAI `/embeddings` 协议的上游。服务商地址写到 API 根，凭证是一个 API Key。
description.en: Any upstream that speaks OpenAI's `/embeddings`. The provider endpoint is the API root; the credential is one API key.

description.zh-CN: Azure OpenAI 不带版本号的 v1 向量接口。服务商地址写到 {资源}/openai/v1，凭证是资源的 API Key。
description.en: Azure OpenAI's unversioned v1 embeddings surface. The provider endpoint is {resource}/openai/v1; the credential is the resource's API key.

description.zh-CN: Google Gemini API 的向量接口（generativelanguage.googleapis.com）。凭证是一个 API Key。
description.en: The Google Gemini API's embeddings (generativelanguage.googleapis.com). The credential is one API key.

description.zh-CN: Vertex AI 上的向量模型，凭证是服务账号密钥，网关用它签发访问令牌。
description.en: Embedding models on Vertex AI; the credential is a service account key the gateway mints access tokens from.

region.zh-CN: Vertex AI 的区域，例如 us-central1，或 global。
region.en: The Vertex AI location, such as us-central1, or global.

project.zh-CN: 要调用的 Google Cloud 项目，与服务账号所属项目不同时才填。
project.en: The Google Cloud project to call, when it is not the service account's own.

service_account.zh-CN: 用来签发访问令牌的服务账号密钥文件（JSON）。
service_account.en: The service account key file (JSON) access tokens are minted with.

project_id.zh-CN: 服务账号所属的 Google Cloud 项目。
project_id.en: The Google Cloud project the service account belongs to.
